    Watch out, your staple cowgirl hat is coming through—bold, timeless, and ready for anything. Whether you're headed to a country music festival, a weekend road trip, or just grabbing your favorite latte, the Teddy Cattleman is the felt cowboy hat that pulls it all together. With its classic western cattleman crown and wide brim, it offers a true nod to traditional cowboy style while turning heads wherever you roam. This is the kind of hat that earns compliments on repeat.

    Crafted from high-quality felt, the Teddy Cattleman is built for both fashion and function. Its structured shape keeps things elevated, while the wide brim adds the perfect amount of sun protection for long days outdoors. It's equal parts statement-maker and everyday essential—trust us, it’ll quickly become your signature piece.
